rows.behavior: Provider setting, defaults that replay the v0.1 answers, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and per-provider saved-answer files

claims.claim: DOCKET_MODEL_PROVIDER is openrouter (the default) or anthropic
The defaults, openrouter with openai/gpt-4o-mini, replay the saved v0.1 answers
Live answers use anthropic with the key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; OpenRouter uses OPENROUTER_API_KEY
The runtime picks the Anthropic transport when the provider is anthropic
Keys come from the environment or the gitignored .env
Each provider has its own saved-answer file: evals/recordings/anthropic.jsonl or calls.jsonl
An empty DOCKET_REPLAY_PATH resolves to the provider's file; a set one overrides it
A saved answer's key includes the model name
Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DOCKET_MODEL_PROVIDER=anthropic and DOCKET_MODEL=claude-haiku-5-5 for live answers
Live answers then go to evals/recordings/anthropic.jsonl
An evaluation refuses a --budget above DOCKET_RUN_BUDGET_CAP_USD

rows.behavior: Anthropic transport: structured output with JSON-in-prompt fallback, 15 s timeout, sent versus not-sent failures

claims.claim: Anthropic calls send the schema as structured output
If the API refuses the schema, the process asks for JSON in the prompt from then on
Each live answer records which output mode it used
On Anthropic a rate limit or server error is treated as not sent
A refused connection is treated as not sent
A connection that fails after sending raises MaybeBilled
Each Anthropic request times out after 15 seconds

rows.behavior: Gateway retries, NoAnswer, MaybeBilled charge, unreadable answers and record mode replaying saved answers

claims.claim: The gateway retries after 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds
After the fourth retry an Anthropic call raises NoAnswer
MaybeBilled keeps its worst-case charge and is not resent
Before each call Docket reserves the worst-case cost
Unreadable answers are charged before parsing
Refusal, cut, not JSON and schema failure are the unreadable reasons
UnreadableAnswer is a kind of ParseError
Unreadable answers are saved with their raw text
Replaying an unreadable answer raises the same error
In record mode a request that already has a saved answer is replayed instead of sent
None of the gateway errors is retried by Temporal
Record mode sends only requests with no saved answer
Each live answer keeps its raw text, tokens, cost, latency and output mode
Record mode also writes each request to evals/pending/

rows.behavior: Price snapshot, token-based cost with a long-prompt tier, and the run budget cap

claims.claim: Anthropic costs are API tokens times the prices in config/model_prices.yaml
Prompts above the long-prompt line use the long prices
An evaluation refuses a run budget above DOCKET_RUN_BUDGET_CAP_USD
DOCKET_RUN_BUDGET_CAP_USD defaults to $5.00

rows.behavior: Model activity deadline and the no_answer and maybe_billed failure reasons

claims.claim: The classify and choose steps get 120 seconds in Temporal
A gateway call with every retry takes less than that deadline
In choose, the workflow records no suggestion and the error reason
The reasons include no_answer and maybe_billed

rows.behavior: Live exchange file: pack_exchange --live packs the request behind each live answer, and --check verifies it

claims.claim: pack_exchange.py --live packs requests into evals/recordings/anthropic-exchange.jsonl.gz
Each live recording must have its exact request in that file
--check also checks the live file against the live recordings when either exists

rows.behavior: Live report banner, record-mode counts, and no mixing of live with other answers

claims.claim: A record report counts recorded_before_run and requests_to_send
A report refuses to mix live answers with simulated or OpenRouter answers
A live report opens with a line naming the model and the date or dates

rows.behavior: reproduce_eval replays a stored report under that report's own model and provider

claims.claim: The replay check replays under the model and provider the report was measured with

rows.behavior: Spike: two calls, $0.05 on Anthropic writing ADR 008, $0.50 on OpenRouter writing ADR 001

claims.claim: The Anthropic spike has a $0.05 budget
It writes docs/adr/008-spike-result.json
It writes the Spike section of ADR 008
The OpenRouter spike budget is $0.50

rows.behavior: Secret scan skips only the root .env, verify.sh fails unless git ignores it, and the live exchange file is scanned

claims.claim: verify.sh fails if git does not ignore .env
The scan skips the local .env
detect-secrets also scans the archives' contents, the live one included

rows.behavior: An unreadable category answer sends the document to review

claims.claim: An unreadable category answer, such as a refusal, sends the document to review.

rows.behavior: Cost summary rebuilt from the live recordings

claims.claim: scripts/cost_summary.py writes the cost summary from the recordings

rows.behavior: Regenerating a live report keeps its record-run evidence

claims.claim: regenerate_live_report.py replays a seed and carries the record runs forward

rows.none: Recorded data, not behavior; the evidence archive README and docs/rerecord.md describe the archives.
